title: Sara Duterte arrives in Senate ahead of plenary debates on OVP budget
summary: Senate Committee on Finance Vice Chairperson Senator Risa Hontiveros earlier this month said that she expected Duterte to attend the budget deliberations similar to what other agency heads do, as a…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday went to the Senate minutes before the proposed P785.2 million budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for fiscal year 2027 was deliberated on the Senate floor.
Duterte arrived in the Senate premises past 12 noon.
The Senate then swiftly approved the proposed budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for fiscal year 2027.
Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri quickly moved to extend the traditional courtesy to the OVP, with no senator asking questions.
This was approved by Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian.
Meanwhile, the last time Duterte came to the Senate was on July 7 to meet with her defense lawyers amid her impeachment trial.
The impeachment trial is currently put on hold to give way for the Senate plenary deliberations on the proposed P7.2 trillion budget for next year.

Her defense team has been presenting evidence and witnesses for Article II of the impeachment case, alleging her unexplained wealth due to her supposed failure to truthfully disclose assets in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN), and failure to divest in businesses as constitutionally required for the President and Vice President.
In October, the Senate finance subcommittee panel quickly approved the proposed P785.2 million OVP budget for fiscal year 2027, terminating the briefing after 16 minutes.
Duterte was not present during the budget briefing, but the OVP was represented by its chief of staff, Zuleika Lopez, and other officials.

It was Senator Imee Marcos who then moved to extend the traditional courtesy to the OVP and endorse it to the plenary with no much discussions and interpellations. This was seconded by Senator Bong Go.
But before the briefing was suspended, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian asked where the Vice President was.
Gatchalian noted that during budget deliberations, heads of office traditionally go to Congress to defend the proposed budget of their respective agencies.
The OVP said the P785.204 million budget aims to support the agency’s continued delivery of assistance and services to beneficiaries nationwide.
The 2027 budget recommendation includes P220.232 million for Personnel Services (PS), P561.651 million for Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (MOOE), and P3.321 million for Capital Outlay.
Meanwhile, P15.544 million is automatically appropriated for the Retirement and Life Insurance Premium (RLIP) of OVP plantilla personnel. —VAL, GMA News
